description: What large loads (data centers, crypto mining, industrial plants, LNG, hydrogen and other big electric customers) are planned or being connected in a Texas county, or near an address or coordinate: announced data center campuses tracked by Barrio Energy Research with coordinates, flagged when at or above ERCOT's 75 MW large load threshold (developer, end user, MW, status, utility, substation, abatements, opposition, sources; with an address, also campuses within 25 miles across county lines), load-driven transmission projects from ERCOT's Transmission Project and Information Tracking report (TPIT, monthly), with TSP, substation, kV, stated MW, status and in-service date; TCEQ air permit filings flagged as data centers; Grid Report articles that mention the county; plus the county's load zone and likely utility. With list_counties=true, ranks all 254 counties by large-load signals and lists the counties with none. Use when someone asks what data centers or large loads are coming to a county, how crowded an area is with large load requests, which counties have no large load activity, or who is building near a site. ERCOT does not publish its large load interconnection queue by county or project; this tool assembles the public county-level evidence and says so.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

county.description: Texas county name, e.g. 'Hall' or 'Hall County'. Or pass address or lat/lng.

include_completed.description: Also include load projects TPIT lists as completed in the last year. Default false.

kind.description: For list_counties: large = data centers and large loads only (default), all = also routine load-serving stations, data_center = data centers only.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

limit.description: Projects to return (default 40) or counties to rank (default 25, max 254).

list_counties.description: Rank every county instead of looking at one. Default false.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: With an address or lat/lng: also list announced data center campuses within this many miles, across county lines. Default 25, max 100.

name: large_loads
title: Large loads in a Texas county
